overall: This clearly reads as a single cohesive film about the same four men due to the remarkably consistent character designs, costuming, and visual motifs across every shot. Its biggest weakness is the rigid, repetitive staging where the men awkwardly carry hourglasses and stand under string lights regardless of the environment or action described.
